title: Region-aware SLO escalation playbook + synthetic topology prober
creator: Harini Gupta
description: Goal: Build a combined operational playbook and observability surface that ties region-aware SLO escalation rules to a deterministic synthetic topology prober. This ticket covers instrumentation changes, dashboard panels, alert rules, and a written runbook for on-call operators. Context: incidents in Q4 showed that regional spine congestion + KV cache cold starts cause correlated p95/p99 spikes that aren't visible to global aggregates. We need region-first visibility and deterministic synthetic traffic that exercises admission, KV cache hit/miss, and decode path to validate failover pathways and circuit transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Instrument three new golden signals at region granularity: admit_rate, wordpiece_latency_p99, kv_cache_hit_ratio (per-model and per-shard)
Create a set of Grafana dashboards with region drilldowns and a topology panel that maps failover dependency ordering
Synthetic prober: configurable topology runner that can inject controlled admission pressure, KV cold starts, and simulated PG aborts; results recorded to metrics and traces
Define SLO escalation matrix (warning -> partial-fail -> region-failover) and wire it to PagerDuty runbook links
Automated smoke that validates canary failover path for at least two backup regions and asserts response SLA under shed conditions
